invariants.description: with constant currents Vm is exactly linear: Vm = Vm_init - 1e6 (sum I - i_stim)/C_m t (nA/pF = 1e6 mV/s)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Vm - (Vm_init - 1e6*(i_Ca + i_Na + i_A + i_KV + i_KCa - i_stim)/C_m*t))) <= 1e-6*max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(Vm)))

bc_sweep.rationale: currents +/-1 nA (a sympathetic neuron action potential reaches a few nA of I_Na at most), Vm_init -90 to +30 mV, C_m 10-200 pF (small to large ganglion neurons).

baseline.reason: a pure charge integrator; validation belongs to the assembled Tao 2011 neuron (action potential shape).

calibrate.note: not_applicable: no free parameters besides C_m and the initial value.
